normal_precursor_conditions: Frame is earlier than the configured pre-event exclusion buffer.
Frame itself contains no visible accident evidence.
Source permission and extraction policy are approved.

notes: The paper presents nine base categories and ego/non-ego variants. The inspected official annotation archive uses IDs 1-10 because leaving-left and leaving-right are separate IDs.
Category eligibility never labels every anomaly-window frame as accident. Visible-collision review remains required.
